statements.proposition: This change maintains backward compatibility throughout (existing callers and behaviour keep working).
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Settled by changed signatures (static reading; a runtime probe was blocked by the permission system, so not executed). The change rewrites connection perform_action from (self, action_name, kwargs) to (self, action_name, **kwargs), but ConnectionManager.perform_action at head still calls connection.perform_action(action_name, kwargs) with two positional arguments, which raises TypeError in Python. It also replaces the Action objects in e.g. OpenAIConnection.register_actions with bound methods, while ConnectionManager.list_actions/perform_action at head still read action.parameters and action.description.
